operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] bodies [PATH] markets bodies [PARAMS] body class fields filter groups id market product [SCHEMA] body href links model self vehicle

operations.description:
Returns URLs pointing to images in JPG format in the highest available resolution (depending on the component) of the vehicle's:
  * engine (1024x576 px),
  * rim (710x710 px),
  * trim (800x600 px),
  * paints (800x600 px),
  * upholstery (800x600 px) and
  * equipments (740x416 px).
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] image components [PATH] markets models configurations images components [PARAMS] configuration id market model [SCHEMA] code components equipment error image images map paints response url

operations.description: Returns a URL pointing to an image of the vehicles engine.  These images are available in the resolution 1024x576 px.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] image components engine [PATH] markets models configurations images components engine [PARAMS] configuration id market model [SCHEMA] engine error image response url

operations.description: Returns URLs pointing to images of this vehicle's equipments. The images are available in the highest possible resolution (usually 740x416 px).
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] image components equipments [PATH] markets models configurations images components equipments [PARAMS] configuration id market model [SCHEMA] all equipment error image images map response url

operations.description: Returns URLs pointing to images of this vehicle's equipments. The images are available in the highest possible resolution (usually 740x416 px).
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] image components equipments by code [PATH] markets models configurations images components equipments [PARAMS] code component configuration id market model [SCHEMA] equipment error image response url

operations.description: Returns URLs pointing to images of this vehicles paint.  These images are available in resolution 800x600 px.  Note there might be two paints (e.g. Smart, 'paint' for body panel and 'paint2' for the tridion cell)
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] image components paint [PATH] markets models configurations images components paint [PARAMS] configuration id market model [SCHEMA] code error image images paint paints response

operations.description: Returns a URL pointing to an image of the vehicles rim.  These images are available in the resolution 710x710 px.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] image components rim [PATH] markets models configurations images components rim [PARAMS] configuration id market model [SCHEMA] code error image response rim

operations.description: Returns a URL pointing to an image of this vehicles trim.  These images are available in resolution 800x600 px.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] image components trim [PATH] markets models configurations images components trim [PARAMS] configuration id market model [SCHEMA] code error image response trim

operations.description: Returns URLs pointing to images of the vehicle's upholsteries. Tge images are available in the highest possible resolution (usually 800x600 px).
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] image components upholstery [PATH] markets models configurations images components upholstery [PARAMS] configuration id market model [SCHEMA] code error image response upholstery

operations.description: Returns URLs pointing to PNG images of a vehicle with a white background.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] image vehicle [PATH] markets models configurations images vehicle [PARAMS] configuration id market model night open perspectives roof [SCHEMA] error image response url vehicle with
